purposeStatement: A single collapsible section whose header row toggles a body region; use to progressively disclose secondary content. NOT for mutually-exclusive tabbed panels (use a tab component) and NOT for focus-trapping overlays (use a modal).

antiPatterns.pattern: A raw <div> with an onClick handler and inline padding/border that shows/hides content
antiPatterns.reason: Re-invents disclosure as a token-less one-off, losing surface/border/radius consistency and accessible aria-expanded/region semantics.
